context_requirements: Expression of thyroid peroxidase (TPO), which is essentially restricted to thyroid follicular cells
Expression of type I iodothyronine deiodinase (DIO1), which is not a major pathway in most of these lines
An intact thyroid hormone synthesis pathway, absent in the nine tested non-thyroid human cell lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is not explained by generic stress or proliferation effects
Evidence of TPO or DIO1 expression and functional dependence in any of the tested lines
